svg.aria-label: Four ways to fill the 3 missing ages (rows 2, 3 and 9) in raw_data.csv. fillna(0) puts 0.0 in each gap; fillna(mean) puts the mean of the 8 known ages, 32.75; ffill() copies the value above, giving 29.0 for all three; bfill() copies the value below, giving 34.0, 34.0 and 31.0.
svg.title: Filling missing values
